subject.title: fix(channels): progress drafts only for long tasks, with the model's own preamble as the status headline

question: Should the three optional GetReplyOptions progress-lifecycle fields become the permanent public Plugin SDK contract for channel-owned progress presentation?
rationale: The fields are additive and technically coherent, but they establish a new external plugin boundary whose permanence and naming require repository-owner intent rather than automated correctness judgment.

options.title: Accept the typed lifecycle seam
options.body: Keep the three optional fields as the canonical channel-owned contract after the Discord gate race is repaired and compatibility tests remain green.

options.title: Keep lifecycle wiring internal
options.body: Remove the public SDK additions and route the lifecycle through an internal bundled-channel seam, avoiding a new external plugin commitment.

options.title: Pause the broader headline work
options.body: Land only the purely time-based gate fix in a narrower change and revisit preamble headlines and lifecycle APIs separately.

recommendation.title: Accept the typed lifecycle seam
recommendation.body: Keep the three optional fields as the canonical channel-owned contract after the Discord gate race is repaired and compatibility tests remain green.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the most direct recent history across the compositor, narrator, channel adapters, and proposed SDK boundary.
